definitions.explanation: Physically facing or oriented toward the back.
Having a negative or passive attitude toward something. The opposite of {前向|まえむ}き (positive, forward-looking).

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: He was standing with his back turned.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧はやめよう。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing will change with a negative attitude.

notes:
{後|うし}ろ{向|む}き has both a physical meaning (facing backward) and a figurative meaning (pessimistic, negative). The figurative sense is more commonly used in everyday conversation.

USAGE:
Can function as both a noun and a na-adjective:
- Na-adjective: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a negative attitude)
- Adverb: {後|うし}ろ{向|む}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think negatively)
The ⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧ pattern is productive: ⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧ (forward), ⟦{横向|よこむ}き→横向き：17271_yokomuki⟧ (sideways), ⟦{上向|うわむ}き→上向き：27459_uwamuki⟧ (upward), {下向|したむ}き (downward).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: negative thinking
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧: pessimistic remarks
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}きな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: passive/negative attitude
- {後|うし}ろ{向|む}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to fall backward (physical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧: forward-looking, positive, proactive
